source.title: Nyangumarta Warrarn Aboriginal Corporation and Rio Tinto sign milestone agreement for Winu Project

evidence.claim: Rio Tinto and the Nyangumarta Warrarn Aboriginal Corporation signed a Project Agreement for the proposed Winu copper-gold mine on Nyangumarta Country, a concrete development and social-licence milestone for a next-generation copper growth option.
evidence.limitations: Agreement milestone does not establish final investment decision, construction approval, production timing, project economics, or future operating performance. No score or underwriting judgment is made.
